evidence: Ally Invest officially states there is no minimum deposit required to open a Self-Directed brokerage cash account.

Ally's official real-time quote FAQ states real-time quotes are automatically enabled only for funded, non-professional accounts. This funding condition violates XRAY strict G9-C even though the cash account itself has no opening minimum.
Ally requires exchange market-data agreements for real-time market data; without them, only delayed data is available.
Ally's official account-opening FAQ requires the user to be a U.S. resident with a U.S. street address, so the current user in Türkiye is not eligible for the retail path.
Ally has a sanctioned Invest API surface, but its API agreement includes compliance testing and does not override the funded-account real-time market-data condition or U.S.-residency requirement.
reopen_condition: Only reopen if Ally provides real-time consolidated National-NBBO API access to an unfunded account permanently at $0 and expands eligible retail residency to Türkiye.
